feature_policy: Unchanged accepted float32 root User features; User node_type is constant and omitted. Distinct-neighbor features mean this User's own observed distinct IP counts, computable from its login history. No other node's attributes, shared-IP user counts, edges, adjacency, message passing, embeddings, IDs, provenance or ground truth enter the model.
preprocessing: No learned normalization; same fixed accepted log1p counts and failure ratio as GraphSAGE

training.batch_order: unchanged accepted chronological cached minibatches; no shuffle

selection.epoch_selection: AP improvement greater than 1e-6; otherwise retain earlier epoch; patience=3
selection.scope: independent per organization; never choose one organization model for another

metrics: Reuse accepted classification_metrics; nominal 0.5 precision/recall/F1 are diagnostic only, not fixed-FPR outcomes
reproducibility: Retrain selected candidate from same seed and compare exact model tensors, epoch and all VAL logits
search_budget_rationale: Two widths, two hidden transformations, optimizer/loss/epoch limit/patience and eligible minibatches match accepted GraphSAGE. Parameter counts differ because neighborhood branches are deliberately removed; no extra comparator search after outcomes. One initialization per organization plus exact repeat, matching accepted evidence.
